positive.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT b.user_id, b.currency_id,
       CASE
           WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "user" u WHERE u.id = b.user_id)
            AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM currency c WHERE c.id = b.currency_id) THEN 'no user, no currency'
           WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "user" u WHERE u.id = b.user_id) THEN 'no user'
           ELSE 'no currency'
       END AS problem
FROM balance b
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "user" u WHERE u.id = b.user_id)
   OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM currency c WHERE c.id = b.currency_id)
ORDER BY b.user_id, b.currency_id;

negative.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT b.user_id, b.currency_id, 'no user' AS problem
FROM balance b
LEFT JOIN "user" u ON u.id = b.user_id
WHERE u.id IS NULL
ORDER BY b.user_id, b.currency_id;

SELECT b.user_id, b.currency_id,
       CASE
           WHEN u.id IS NULL AND c.id IS NULL THEN 'no user, no currency'
           WHEN u.id IS NULL THEN 'no user'
           ELSE 'no currency'
       END AS problem
FROM balance b
LEFT JOIN "user" u ON u.id = b.user_id
LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT id FROM currency) c ON c.id = b.currency_id
WHERE u.id IS NULL OR c.id IS NULL
ORDER BY b.user_id, b.currency_id;
